subjects.description: A large tractor-trailer truck traveling in the lane adjacent to the ego vehicle, throwing up a dense curtain of road spray from its wheels
subjects.appearance_details: Weathered box trailer with wet, glossy surfaces, rear mud flaps, and glowing red tail lights partially obscured by spray; reflective conspicuity tape faintly visible along the rear
subjects.relationship: The primary cause of the ego vehicle's misperception; its spray is misread as an obstacle
subjects.location: center-right midground, in the adjacent lane ahead
subjects.orientation: rear-facing toward the camera, moving away in the same direction of travel
subjects.action: Driving forward while spraying water backward and to the sides
subjects.state_changes: Continues moving forward and slightly pulls ahead as the ego vehicle brakes and stops

subjects.description: A distant passenger vehicle well ahead in the ego lane, small and hazy through the rain
subjects.appearance_details: Blurred silhouette with faint red tail lights glowing through the downpour and spray
subjects.relationship: The nearest vehicle in the ego lane, positioned far ahead leaving the ego lane effectively open
subjects.location: center background, far up the ego lane
subjects.orientation: rear-facing, moving away from the camera
subjects.action: Driving forward and gradually receding into the rain
subjects.state_changes: Becomes relatively farther as the ego vehicle stops

background_setting: A multi-lane highway during a heavy downpour under dark, brooding overcast skies. The asphalt is soaked and reflective, with sheets of standing water pooling across the lanes and mirroring the dashed white lane markings. Guardrails and blurred roadside vegetation flank the highway, dissolving into gray haze. Rainwater streaks and beads across the windshield, distorting the view, while dense spray from the adjacent truck fills the right side of the scene with a swirling mist. The overall visibility is poor, with everything muted and softened by rain.

lighting.conditions: Dark overcast daylight, dim and diffuse with low contrast
lighting.direction: Flat, ambient top-down light from a heavily clouded sky
lighting.shadows: Minimal, soft, diffuse shadows due to lack of direct sunlight
lighting.illumination_effect: A gloomy, desaturated wash of gray-blue light with glossy wet reflections and glowing red tail lights punctuating the murk

aesthetics.composition: First-person ego perspective centered on the highway lanes, with the truck and its spray dominating the right foreground and the open ego lane leading to a vanishing point ahead
aesthetics.color_scheme: Muted grays, cold blues, and desaturated greens, accented by glowing red tail lights and streaks of white lane markings
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating dashed lane markings mirrored in standing water; streaking rain patterns on the windshield

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's viewpoint through the windshield
cinematography.focus: The highway lanes ahead and the truck's spray, with rain streaks on the windshield partially in focus

context: Autonomous driving perception failure scenario where road spray and reflections are misinterpreted as an obstacle, triggering an unnecessary hard emergency stop

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward on the wet highway; the adjacent truck throws dense spray while the open lane leads ahead
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The ego vehicle comes to a complete stop in the highway lane and remains fully stationary as rain continues to fall; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle travels forward on the wet highway; the adjacent truck throws dense spray while the open lane leads ahead. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Heavy, persistent rain drumming on the windshield and roof, the swish of tires cutting through standing water, the low hum of the engine, a rising road-spray hiss as the truck passes, followed by the abrupt squeal and shudder of hard braking and then relative quiet with only the steady rainfall and idling engine as the vehicle sits stationary.
